rankingRule: expectedGain minus expectedCost; only fixed cost 2 for correctness or measurement-sensitive changes

hypotheses.title: Branch the replay corpus after an acted overtaken ghost, preserving the recovery ordering
hypotheses.description: Replace the replay-prefix child implementation with full-state continuations from the first completed scheduler step at which State.overtaken_ghost_acted becomes true. This flag is set after exec returns only when a dead-incarnation record entered a restarted receiver that already heard the sender's current incarnation and the handler changed its state token. Port the saved state-fork start/resume machinery to current path.rs, explorer.rs and campaign.rs; retain State, PathState, plan cursor, cap, eligibility bookkeeping, logs, client history and pending operations, and resume under independently derived schedule streams. Admit only fresh, non-probe parents that reach this checkpoint before their effective cap; no children become parents. The corpus remains capacity 64 and eight total children per parent, round-robin. Both child cells receive the same parent's workload, configuration and actual ArmSet, and parent selection never reads the prefix bit. REPLAY_PREFIX children resume the checkpoint; other REPLAY_SLOT children run that same plan and ArmSet from the initial state with fresh draws. Both cells are excluded from selector posterior credit so an inherited success is not counted as new training evidence; parents retain ordinary credit. Empty-corpus slots execute fresh and retain their assigned tags. Do not reset or extend the inherited step cap. Keep original client call times and responses in each child's complete output history, remap only the output run id, and never combine suffixes into one history. Export parent id, checkpoint step and suffix digest through subject-side run diagnostics so sibling diversity can be checked without modifying the grader. Files: simulator/path.rs, core/scheduler.rs, explorer.rs, campaign.rs, replay_corpus.rs, run_variant.rs and util_stats.rs. No config key, no campaign arm change. The existing registered replayPrefix bit retains its exact meaning: a child takes a saved execution prefix rather than only a saved plan. There is no separate fork-vs-tape or alternate-cut cell in this proposal.
hypotheses.rationale: Both failed forks conserved almost no work: the original signal cut was 184 of 2430 steps, and the last-recover cut 321 of 4400. The mechanism here is conditioning, not cheaper tails. Those checkpoints preceded the rare post-restart reordering; the acted-overtaken checkpoint preserves that ordering exactly and spends sibling schedules on its consequences. Current tape fidelity was 0.23 at iteration 54. The current corpus already buys roughly 2x through workload selection, while imperfect tape adds only about 1.11x; a later semantic checkpoint can retain substantially more than the old signal. The cut may still occur early in wall time, which is not itself a failure; improved extension probability must pay its cost. The current flag and its after-handler site are verified in core/scheduler.rs around lines 1440-1455. This is not the closed last-planned-recover cut.
hypotheses.generalityArgument: The checkpoint uses only incarnation history, a receiver's observed newer traffic, and whether a handler wrote state. It names no protocol message, role, label, or oracle event. Every protocol with crash recovery and delayed messages has this possible structural boundary. Protocols without eligible checkpoints fall back to their existing fresh simulation; panel results remain binding.

prediction.mechanism: Treatment bit replayPrefix = 1 << 21, already registered, nested in replaySlot = 1 << 20. Half of non-probe replay slots are assigned by the existing salted run-id draw, about one quarter of eligible grid runs. Untreated means replay-slot plan-only children, not all fresh runs. Primary frozen prediction: probe-free, co-bit-matched treated/control depth>=8 per-run ratio in [1.50, 3.00]. The saved prefix is the treatment and has no natural inverse beyond the existing plan-only cell. Also require this prefix/plan ratio to exceed the same contrast on the paired baseline by at least 25%, so the existing replay benefit cannot buy a merge. Shared corpus admission and excluding child pseudo-observations affect both cells; therefore paired cross-binary depth>=8 per-run must be at least 1.08, and depth>=8 per explore-second must exceed baseline. Cross-binary throughput floor is 0.95. Descendant depth>=11 and violations are reported separately from inherited prefix successes. Judge clarification: compute intention-to-treat prefix/plan contrasts over assigned non-probe grid slots, retaining fresh fallbacks. Match campaign arm and actual scheduling co-bits; report selector-origin tag effects separately. Freeze common-support weights from the paired baseline and report unsupported strata. Raw inherited depth counts alone never establish extension. The existing-bit difference-in-differences must reach 1.25 and cross-binary per-run ratio 1.08 in addition to the raw treatment ratio; there is no new independent fork-vs-tape cell.
prediction.independentObservable: At least 4000 distinct eligible checkpoint parents and 20000 resumed children per chunk; fewer than 30% of assigned prefix slots fall back fresh. At least 70% of sibling suffix digests are distinct within their parent (first 32 post-checkpoint message entries, short suffixes included), and at least 90% of resumed children execute another message entry. For the new-depth gate, use a conservative observable requiring no new oracle instrumentation: across four chunks at least 75 distinct parent run ids whose COMPLETE original run had depth<11 must each produce at least one resumed child with depth>=11. Such a parent necessarily had depth<11 at the cut; count that family only once. This is a lower bound on new continuation progress, not an inherited-depth gain. Report all child depth>=11 counts separately, as they include inherited successes. Join existing emitted per-run grade depths to subject parent-id diagnostics before outputs are removed. Clone time below 2% of aggregate worker simulation time and added peak RSS below 2 GiB per grid arm.
prediction.falsifier: Refute if the matched primary interval lies entirely below 1.50, if paired improvement of prefix/plan ratio is below 1.25, or if cross-binary depth>=8 per-run is below 1.08. Refute the search explanation if sibling distinctness is below 70%, fewer than 90% continue to another message entry, or the new depth>=11 descendant-parent floor is missed. Insufficient checkpoint supply or fallback above 30% closes before interpreting rates. Any mismatched prefix client history, extended inherited cap, or lost pending client call is an implementation fault, never a finding. Throughput below 0.95 or no net primary events-per-second gain closes on cost. Siblings are correlated: report parent-count sensitivity alongside the fixed grader interval; eight copies of one deep prefix cannot constitute eight independent discoveries. No harness changes are authorized to repair power. Judge rewrite: replace the ambiguous newly-reach-depth>=11 parent gate with the conservative parent-complete-depth<11 gate above. Report a parent-cluster analysis with both child cells clustered together and sensitivity inflation sqrt(1+(8-1)*0.5)=2.121 in addition to the fixed grader interval; a gain that depends on counting siblings independently cannot pass. Preserve the existing grader unchanged. A raw depth>=8 pass without the new-continuation gate closes the discovery explanation.

hypotheses.notes: Evidence: observations iterations 54 and 59-65; current scheduler's acted overtaken flag; replay_corpus.rs capacity, child budget and salted slots; saved state-fork patch preserves history and scheduler locals. Largest risks: stronger parent conditioning also improves plan-only controls; sparse parents starve slots; child-credit removal slows selector maturation; inherited arm mixes require explicit matching rather than reading child's random arm bits. Judge should price those costs rather than assuming a late cut buys throughput. No orchestrator edit or bit registration is needed. Full-state clone fidelity and independent suffix streams need tests before grading.

review.redTeam: A later checkpoint can manufacture depth>=8 counts by copying already deep prefixes, without producing new deep continuations or violations. Iteration 27 already found deeper replay served finished states. Stronger admission also improves plan-only workloads; ArmSet inheritance and removing child credit change both cells and the global selector. Current tape fidelity is materially better than the historical 0.23, so old fidelity arithmetic overstates headroom. The acted signal may be sparse among fresh parents, starving slots; clone and history work may erase any throughput gain. Eight correlated siblings must not be treated as eight discoveries.
verifiedEvidence: core/state.rs:1209 and core/scheduler.rs:1286-1305,1440-1447 implement the incarnation/heard predicate and after-exec token-change flag exactly as claimed.
replay_corpus.rs:29-48 has salted slot/prefix allocation, probe exclusion, capacity 64 and total child budget 8; campaign.rs:417-430 assigns the parent without consulting prefix treatment.

campaign.rs:451-535 currently admits tape parents and reruns children from initial state; saved state-fork-recover-cut/spur.patch contains clone/resume machinery with history, pending events and inherited effective cap. Porting is necessary; fidelity is not established for this new implementation.

Historical iteration 54 cuts are 184/2430 and 321/4400; iteration 27 deep-tier failure and iteration 28 parent-arm inheritance are relevant adverse evidence, but neither tested this acted-restarted checkpoint as a full-state conditioning intervention.

Current baseline 34b5ef40e3bf-30-f9daa01b-300-g870d4c11-s3d907a50.json: seeds 1000/1001 have 72959/71910 parents, 108506/108175 prefix children, 56198/54542 faithful prefixes (0.518/0.504), and 18454/17996 unfilled slots. Raw assigned-prefix versus assigned-plan depth>=8 ratios are 1.063/1.043, not a current 1.11 claim. These raw ratios are not the matched decision statistic.

Baseline depth>=11 counts are 27 and 27 for 606180 and 603480 runs. No current counter measures acted-checkpoint parent supply, suffix diversity or newly extended depth; these are proposed subject diagnostics, not verified current counters.
review.dedupe: Supersedes the closed last-recover fork for implementation reuse only. The earlier throughput-saving cut and deep tape tiers are already answered; this proposal is admitted solely for exact structural conditioning plus genuinely new continuations. Do not also admit another cut or parent-inheritance variant in this iteration.
review.costReason: Fixed rubric cost 2: checkpointing and re-emitting complete client histories is measurement/correctness-sensitive even without editing history.rs.
requiredImplementationConstraints: Snapshot after the complete scheduler step and retain all client histories, original call/response times, pending operations, eligibility state, plan cursor and effective cap. No reset or extension of cap. Fidelity and independent suffix tests are smoke gates.

Use actual inherited ArmSet for child mechanism tags. Selector learner tags must describe actual choosing/credit semantics; do not falsely tag a newly sampled learner as the chooser of inherited arms. Both child cells are excluded from selector credit; empty-corpus fresh slots still retain slot assignment tags.

Export bounded subject diagnostics keyed by child run id and parent run id: checkpoint step, actual ArmSet, cap, suffix message count, first-32-entry suffix digest, clone worker time, and explicit dropped-row count. Any dropped rows affecting a gate make that gate unmeasurable and close the run; no harness changes.
Use existing emitted per-run grade depths joined read-only to diagnostics. Never introduce oracle depth into simulator decisions or counters.

hypotheses.title: Choose later scheduling directions conditionally on the cell's most decided axis
hypotheses.description: Replace independent axis sampling in arm_selector.rs with a hierarchical conditional draw. Keep the current three rewards, cell keys, exposure policy, marginal Beta tables, exploration-share rule and first-axis pick. On each learner draw, choose the first axis by largest current leader margin, tie by axis index. Draw its direction using the current coin-times-leading rule. For each remaining axis, draw from conditional Beta tables indexed by that first axis's chosen direction and the candidate direction, with an empirical prior centered on the candidate direction's existing marginal posterior mean. Use WARMUP_OBSERVATIONS as the prior mass; conditional counts replace their prior continuously as evidence arrives. Only pairs of different axes are stored: 57 unordered direction pairs for the current widths [3,2,2,2,3], each with success/failure mass. Each credited run updates its ten observed pairs in the same existing cell write guard, under the current DISCOUNT and the learner's unchanged bool reward. Pair posteriors are read in either orientation. A conditional candidate needs at least WARMUP_OBSERVATIONS raw pair observations before it can differ from the marginal; otherwise it uses the existing marginal distribution exactly. All other axes condition on the first draw only, not the growing tuple, avoiding the 72-combination sample problem. Add counters for conditional draws, fallback draws, pair observations and positive rewards, direction departures versus the marginal draw probabilities, and active parent-axis choices. Keep probe and coin-drawn schedules unchanged. No new config key and no campaign arm change; files arm_selector.rs and util_stats.rs only, plus meaningful unit tests.
hypotheses.rationale: The selector currently attributes the same reward independently to all five carried directions and then samples their marginal posteriors independently. Recovery reordering plausibly depends on combinations: a fresh-first direction can interact with pair send order and client deferral, while the strongest fault direction supplies the prerequisite. The existing implementation already concentrates B on retarget and C on hold, but leaves other axes weakly decided; conditioning those remaining choices on a reliably selected prerequisite can expose interactions concealed in the marginal mixture. This is a structural model change, not another scarce deep reward. It avoids the rejected 72-arm rarity learner in three ways: only two-way cells are learned, each run supplies ten pair observations, and conditional cells back off to today's proven marginal learner. It keeps iteration 65's forbidden cross-credit out: no learner receives another learner's runs and there are no extra shared-map lock acquisitions.
hypotheses.generalityArgument: The rule uses only the explorer's existing generic strategy axes and their existing protocol-agnostic rewards. It makes no axis pair privileged in source and names no protocol message or role. The most decided axis is selected independently per cell and learner, so protocol panels can choose different prerequisites.

prediction.mechanism: Cross-binary rung, not a claimed randomized within-session contrast. This proposal replaces the session-global cell model and its subsequent training distribution for all learner draws; turning off one run's conditional pick does not turn off the conditional model's influence on the shared marginal and pair evidence read by later controls. No existing bit distinguishes this model replacement, and no retired bit is relabeled. A genuinely isolated dual-model trial would be a different implementation with different sample economics. Frozen primary: paired candidate/baseline depth>=8 per graded run in [1.08, 1.20] over the unchanged four-seed evaluation. Require paired depth>=8 events per explore-second above 1.05 as well. Throughput floor 0.97 of baseline. Existing learner tags retain their meanings and are descriptive, not a treatment/control claim.
prediction.independentObservable: At least 20 configuration/learner cells per chunk each make at least 100 supported conditional axis decisions: their actual chosen parent direction and candidate axis have at least two compared candidate directions with >=100 raw pair observations and >=5 raw positive rewards apiece. Each of those two compared pairs must also retain discounted observation mass >=24 and discounted positive mass >=2 at the actual decision; lifetime counts alone do not qualify a draw. Report current discounted success/failure mass alongside these raw counts. At least 15% of supported decisions change the most likely final categorical direction relative to marginal coin-times-leading weights; count only decisions meeting the support gate. Export per-cell support and comparison counters in subject utilStats. Existing A/B/C own-run reward rates each stay >=0.95 of baseline, read by actual learner tag. Replace the unavailable distinct-parent-count claim with fresh non-replay-slot runs reaching depth>=11: their count across four paired chunks is predicted >=1.5x baseline, reported together with their exposure-normalized rate. This last claim is exploratory and cannot override primary harm; it does not count existing correlated replay children as new parents.
prediction.falsifier: Refute if the cross-binary depth>=8 per-run interval lies entirely below 1.08, throughput falls below 0.97, or primary events-per-second fail 1.05. Close for insufficient mechanism support if the 20-cell pair evidence floor is missed; raw total pair updates alone do not count as learning. Refute the interaction explanation if supported choices change their marginal leader on less than 15% of draws or any existing learner reward falls below 0.95 of baseline. Report failure of the depth>=11 count prediction even if the primary improves. Do not relabel a thin conditional table as successful adaptive switching. Judge rewrite: interpret the 15% condition using final coin-weighted direction probabilities and the supported-axis-decision denominator. Use fresh non-slot depth>=11 count/rate for the exploratory deep check; no parent-id instrumentation outside the proposed file scope is required. Shared-model adaptation means no learner bit supplies a randomized treatment comparison. Existing intervals are descriptive of the fixed evaluation; do not claim independence of ten pair updates from one run.

hypotheses.notes: Evidence: arm_selector.rs currently has 12 marginal directions, 500-observation discounted windows and independent sample_axis_leading calls; ArmSet widths verified in run_variant.rs. Number of unordered cross-axis direction pairs is ((12*12)-(3*3+2*2+2*2+2*2+3*3))/2 = 57. Ten pairs per observed five-axis arm set. This does not assert interaction evidence already exists: it is a falsifiable mechanism hypothesis. Pair update hot-path cost and rare rewards are major red-team risks; five positive rewards per supported pair is deliberately binding. Pilot proves arm quality can improve but does not prove this mechanism or remove cap maturation. Do not carry state between grader chunks. No orchestrator edit, no new registration, no measurement-only iteration.

review.redTeam: There is no verified evidence that the remaining directions interact in a way these existing rewards can use. Strong marginal axes may already explain almost all reward variation; conditioning on their leader merely fragments data and double-counts marginal evidence in the empirical prior. The first axis is selected for certainty, not for predictive interaction. Pair observations arise under an adaptive policy and are not randomized causal interaction estimates. A 500-visit discounted window and sparse minority directions may leave few supported positive pairs. Extra arithmetic inside the shared cell guard can recreate part of iteration 65 throughput loss even without extra locks; choosing directions conditionally can also reduce coverage or alter AOS through shared feedback.
verifiedEvidence: run_variant.rs:128-135 widths are [3,2,2,2,3], 12 directions and 72 full combinations; there are exactly 57 unordered cross-axis direction pairs and 10 pair observations per five-axis run.

arm_selector.rs:75,79,242-250,337-377,394-417 confirms discount 0.998, warmup 24, empirical prior, independent categorical coin-times-leading picks and an existing cell guard. Discount currently applies on each carried direction visit, not uniformly to every direction on every cell run. Pair discount semantics must follow that same visit-clock convention.

arm_selector.rs:450-499 credits coin-drawn runs to all three learners and learner-drawn runs only to their own learner. Preserving this policy is compatible with the proposal; no extra cross-learner credit is authorized.

Current baseline seed1000 has 164617/172588/167628 learner chosen runs and 9593/30766/9078 own-run positive rewards for A/B/C. The proposed pair counters and support cells do not exist; positive-pair supply is an unverified prediction, not established by aggregate reward counts.

Pool joint Thompson is held with weak evidence and unbuildable original sample economics; pair backoff is a distinct conditional factorization but belongs to the same joint-learning family, so only this form ranks here.

Iterations 59 and 64 show scarce reward failures; iteration 65 cross-credit lost throughput and changed evidence mixtures. Stage A shows arm quality improving but cannot isolate selector maturation from cap changes, and its rising coin share contradicts a simple fewer-coins story.
review.dedupe: Keep as the sole conditional/joint selector proposal, behind the fork. Do not co-admit the held full 72-combination Thompson or Exp3 designs.
review.costReason: Rubric cost 0: arm_selector.rs and util_stats.rs changes do not alter event execution, history or linearizability recording.
requiredImplementationConstraints: Keep coin/probe policy, rewards, existing marginal updates and cell keys unchanged. Pair tables update in the existing credited learner guard; ten pair increments are correlated observations of one reward, not ten independent reward samples.

Use marginal coin-times-leading probability vectors for fallback and parent-axis choice. Define disagreement against the argmax of the final categorical weight vector, including coin weights, not just highest posterior mean.

Export support diagnostics per cell/learner and parent-axis/candidate-axis pair, distinguishing lifetime raw exposures, current discounted success/failure mass and raw positive rewards. Total pair updates alone cannot satisfy the gate. Support at a decision additionally requires discounted observation mass >=24 and discounted positive mass >=2 for each of two compared pair directions; lifetime positive counts cannot substitute for present evidence.

Pair prior stays centered on the current marginal posterior mean with mass 24; observed counts dominate continuously. Do not describe correlated empirical-prior mass as independent evidence. Reset all added state with the session.

reviewSummary: Both proposals are actionable mechanisms. Fork ranks first 7-2=5; conditional selector second 4-0=4. Predictions above are frozen before implementation. No new harness, oracle, protocol or campaign-arm edits are admitted.
